body:
## About the Old Mill office Our Old Mill office sits in a restored timber building at the end of Mill Race Lane, across from the old millpond. It is the quietest of our offices and the one families with young kids tend to love. The waiting area has a reading nook, and every treatment room has a ceiling screen for cartoons. [Dr. Priya Natarajan](/team/dr-priya-natarajan) leads the team here, with a special focus on kids and families. Hygiene visits are often with [Luis Ortega](/team/luis-ortega). ## Care at this office
  • Kids checkups from the first tooth
  • Cleanings, exams and sealants
  • Tooth-colored fillings
  • Clear aligners for teens and adults
## Getting here Follow Mill Race Lane to the end, past the footbridge over the mill race. The building has a ramp at the side entrance, and strollers are welcome in every room.

Bringing a child for the first time? Tell us when you book. We will plan a short, relaxed first visit and send a few tips beforehand.
